effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] If [Gesomon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, trash any 3 cards under 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers without cards under it can't suspend until the end of their turn
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) and trash 1 card in your hand.
